review_note: First-pass labels; a second team member should review before these count as human-labelled. Expected statuses assume every passage of data/references/abcd-guidelines.snapshot.json has been approved (the tests approve a copy in memory).

fields.expect: supported, partially_supported, contradicted or unverifiable (the draft-level verification_status)

cases.note: Every claim (7-day validity, members qualify, a new code, 20% off) is in the promo-code guideline.
A gold member given a new code, as the guideline says.
A guest given a new code; the guideline says guests cannot be helped.
Real ABCD case of the same mistake.
The agent asks for 2 of 3 details; the guideline asks for 3 out of 4.
The return rules are supported; the closing pleasantries are not knowledge but are part of the answer.
Returns in original packaging are supported, but the bronze time limit is not stated.

Return-policy FAQ answers are not in the ABCD guidelines, which only say to search the FAQ.

Membership benefits FAQ: not in the guidelines.

split_note: Dev cases use ABCD train/dev-split conversations and SYN cases only; ABCD test-split conversations are kept for the held-out set.
